generator_assessments.assessment: The histopathologic findings of a subepidermal tumor with cord-like connections and glycogen accumulation are characteristic of Eccrine poroma.

raw_support_spans.text: Histopathologic findings showed plate-like subepidermal tumor extending horizontally under epidermis with multiple cord-like connections to overlying epidermis
Neoplastic cords consisted of clear/pale epithelial cells with cytoplasm showing strong periodic acid-Schiff staining due to glycogen accumulation

generator_assessments.assessment: The presence of hypopigmented macules and absence of hair growth are characteristic of Nevus depigmentosus.
